business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Brand values stated as "Crafted for the evolved Indian man, blending comfort, design and individuality. Homegrown roots with global appeal, reflecting refined aesthetics across work, travel and leisure."
- Strategic priority 04 frames the end-market as premium casualwear: "A strong brand, a diversified distribution network and a customer-centric strategy position the Company well in premium casualwear."
- Industry backdrop cited as supportive of branded players: "Consumers continued to consolidate spend towards trusted brands offering differentiated product and consistent value, reinforcing the long-term growth runway for organised retail."
- Company history slide describes a strategic reset in 2020-26: "Unwound departmental store exposure and refocused on Tier 2, 3 and 4 cities through exclusive retail, with online established as a core growth driver."
- Business-model enabler 02: "A consistent brand experience across exclusive outlets, large format stores, multi-brand outlets and digital platforms, with inventory optimised through data insight."

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- MD & CEO states the governing philosophy: "Operational excellence, prudent capital allocation and financial discipline will continue to guide how we create sustainable value for our customers, business partners and shareholders."
- Balance sheet as at Jun'26: Share Capital ₹10.13 Cr, Reserves and Surplus ₹173.00 Cr, Non-Current Liabilities ₹38.02 Cr, Current Liabilities ₹205.00 Cr, Total Assets ₹426.15 Cr of which Current Assets ₹375.10 Cr and Non-Current Assets ₹51.05 Cr — an overwhelmingly current-asset (working-capital) balance sheet.
- Capital-raising history per the journey slide: parent Celebrity Fashions went public in 2005 "raising capital to expand Indian Terrain and its manufacturing units", and the Company "Raised growth capital through a QIP" in 2015.
- No dividend, buyback, debt quantum or repayment plan is discussed in the deck.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Demerger history] "2010 — Indian Terrain demerged from Celebrity Fashions and was listed as a separate company"; the brand was launched in 2000 with a single flagship store in Chennai built around casual shirts.
- [Prior strategic misstep] The 2015-20 period is described candidly: "The industry tilted back towards formal wear as competitive intensity rose in smart casuals. Expansion into large cities met high real estate costs, and a move into fashion wear did not deliver."
- [Shareholding as at 30 June 2026] Public 45.49%, Promoters 31.55%, Institutions & Corporate Bodies 17.89%, FPIs & FIIs 5.07%; shares outstanding 5,06,67,367 of ₹2 face value; ISIN INE611L01021.
- [Leadership] Venkatesh Rajagopal, Chairman & Executive Director, founder with over 25 years in apparel; Charath Ram Narsimhan, MD & CEO, IIT graduate with PGDBM (Finance) from IIM Lucknow and over two decades in the garment industry.
- [Filing status] This is a REVISED investor presentation; the covering letter says to "ignore the previous uploaded Investor Presentation" filed the same day, and the results are standalone and un-audited.
